section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1975
title: Volume of Accidental Deaths per Lakh of Population A study of the figures would show that accidental deaths in India did not reveal any definite trend from 1968 to 1975. There was an upward trend to begin with when from 126232 in 1968 the number of accidental deaths increased to 139752 in 1970. After some fall in 1971, there has been a steady increase from 106184 in 1972 to 113016 in 1975. However, the figure of 1975 is lower than the figure of 1968 by 10.5%. Accidental deaths per lakh of population increased in the period 1968-70 from 24.7 to 26.2 while in the period 1971-73 it registered a downward trend & touched 18.5 in 1973. In 1974, it registered a slight increase & stood at 18.9. In 1975 it stood at 18.9. The details regarding the number of accidental deaths year-wise and the volume of accidental deaths per lakh of population for the period 1968-75 are set forth in Table II.
